summary: Codify the existing Generation 10 autonomous evolution architecture as an enforced Evolution Kernel that treats organizations, services, sites, AI providers, databases, frameworks, clouds and domains as replaceable resources behind stable capability and governance contracts.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed EKODI to implement the supplied Evolution Kernel operating model and to shorten delivery time while preserving verification-first operation.
constitutionalInterpretation: This implements and tightens Constitution v1.16.0 without expanding autonomous authority. Human sovereignty, guarded release, independent verification, rollback and production evidence remain mandatory.
implementedCapabilities: Universal Meta Model independent of transient organization and domain names
Knowledge and Source Registry contract with freshness and verification rules
Evolution Resource Registry metadata inheritance for code, model, data, knowledge, workflow and policy
Canonical adoption and retirement lifecycle gates
Additive durable resource and verified-baseline schema
CI validator and regression tests blocking unsafe kernel drift
authorityImpact: None. Production mutation, generation promotion, constitutional authority expansion, destructive actions and high-impact legal, financial, identity or permission decisions remain human-governed.
deploymentImpact: One additive D1 migration prepares durable Evolution Kernel resource and verified-baseline records. Existing guarded migration and release lanes remain authoritative.
rollback: Revert the Evolution Kernel contract, registries, validator, tests, additive migration and workflow gate invocation. Existing Generation 10 capability ecosystem and autonomous evolution loop remain the safe baseline.
